title: VPN connection troubleshooting
content: Restart the VPN client, verify internet connectivity, clear saved credentials, and reconnect using the current company profile.

title: Laptop performance cleanup
content: Close unused applications, check startup apps, verify disk space, run updates, and restart before escalating to desktop support.

title: Email sync repair
content: Confirm network connectivity, restart Outlook, rebuild the profile if needed, and verify mailbox quota.

title: Password reset issues
content: Request a fresh password reset link and complete the reset within the expiration window.

title: Printer queue recovery
content: Clear the printer queue, restart the print spooler, and resend a small test document.

title: Shared drive permissions
content: Confirm the requested folder path and ask the folder owner to grant the correct security group access.

title: Application crash first response
content: Capture the error message, clear the app cache, reinstall the latest approved version, and attach logs to the incident.

title: WiFi connectivity basics
content: Forget the network, reconnect with current credentials, verify signal strength, and test from another device.

title: Blue screen triage
content: Record the stop code, disconnect recent peripherals, boot into safe mode, and run hardware diagnostics.

title: Software installation failure
content: Check admin rights, confirm disk space, retry from the software center, and capture the installer error code.
